about.text: A semi-hard cheese made from cow's milk. It has a firm, dry interior; a creamy texture; and many small, irregular holes. It has a pale tan rind covered in yellow wax. Its flavour is tangy, and it is sometimes seasoned with caraway seeds.

sources.text: Danish, small irregular holes, yellow wax, sometimes with caraway; ripening time not stated in source
